prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in post-adoption (+13.3%, underpredicted) or post-certificate (+5.8%, overpredicted) was helpful, while placing sign-in after the waiting room made results worse (-3.9%) and hand-off timing had no clear effect. Account sync banners were helpful (+2.7%, overpredicted), but pet sync verification hints showed no clear effect.
Path clarity headline updates were helpful (+5.9%, underpredicted), whereas path copy simplification, value proposition refreshes, clear outcome headlines, and time expectation banners showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%, overpredicted) and background hatching readiness status (+3.3%, underpredicted) were helpful, but 3D progress trackers and detailed progress details showed no clear effect.
Photo quality guides with companion preview were helpful (+7.6%, overpredicted), while compact grid layouts (-7.7%) and photo fallback flows (-11.8%) made results worse; split upload assistants showed no clear effect.
System tray location notification tips were helpful (+3.8%), but first interaction tips made results worse (-6.5%), and sound notifications, spawn alerts, mascot welcome stages, and interaction badges showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, incentive: +7.6% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, layout: -7.7% over 1 test(s)

- finish, redesign: +3.8% over 1 test(s)

- home, redesign: +5.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.1% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +1.6% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.3% over 4 test(s)

1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Hatching Animation Progress Status: Add an animated hatching mascot component with detailed readiness state text while background rendering completes. (why: The waiting screen (home step) takes a median 201s / mean 2336s, and support emails noted app stalling or pets failing to appear.)

(why: Support received multiple complaints about custom pet creation failing or generating unexpected visual output.)
3: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Visibility & Tray Controls Tip: Display a explicit tray control callout tip on the home intro screen detailing how to show, hide, or mute the companion. (why: Multiple users contacted support asking how to control or hide the desktop companion post-onboarding.)
